title: Training Volume, Sleep and Endurance Performance: A Longitudinal Analysis of 29 Official Races in a Competitive Distance Runner
description: This exploratory single-athlete case study links Garmin Connect training and recovery data with 29 official FIDAL race results from 2023-2026. The strongest complete-data associations with event-relative official race performance were 56-day running volume, 28-day running volume, 28-day sleep average, 14-day running volume, VO2max nearest to race day, and 14-day sleep average. HRV/RHR exact export coverage was sparse, and screenshot-derived graph digitizations were retained only as supplementary evidence.
